author: reek
body: A token minted outside this compiler, so the expected claim values come from the host that built it rather than from the code under test.

author: reek
body: Three of the four lines are controls. A two-segment token must be refused for its shape; a three-segment token whose payload is not JSON must be refused for its content, which is the case that used to come back as a success carrying empty claims; and the expiry pair must answer differently on either side of the deadline, which is what proves the exp claim was really read. When claims silently failed to parse, exp was zero, zero means no expiry stated, and every expired token passed validation.
